avis.titre: After a month of use: First...
avis.texte: After a month of use: First off, if you have keywords like #redness #combination_dehydrated_skin #sensitive #easily_irritated, you absolutely must buy this. (In bold) Even with just 1 minute of use, it effectively tackles burning sensations and flaking dead skin cells. It's so gentle that even I, who can only use aloe or hyaluronic acid ampoules, find it suitable. The texture is non­sticky and cooling, making it perfect for the upcoming summer. The sheet is large enough to wrap around the mouth area too. After cleansing, I pat it onto my cheeks, apply it around my ampoule or serum, then remove it after 5 minutes. Following up with another layer of ampoule creates a base makeup effect like you'd get at a salon. I even used it every morning during my recent trip to Japan to calm down my skin that had become flaky from the flight. I carried it in a mini zipper bag (the kind you get from Daiso for pills) for touch­ups, but I hardly needed to use it. My skin stayed intact! Highly recommended for both daily use and travel! I wish I could apply it below my mouth and on my chin, but the pad doesn't cut easily. It would be more convenient if there was a tear line in the middle. The case is a bit large compared to the pad size.
Love these toner pads! My face does not feel clean without them

Skin type: Dry, Sensitive Pads: The pads are square gauze and quite large, which is nice. However, being gauze, they tend to fall apart easily, so I mainly used them for exfoliating toner. User experience: I appreciated that the pads were generously soaked in essence, preventing them from drying out. I bought it as part of a promotional set, which included a refill, making it good value for money. However, I was disappointed that I couldn't really feel the effects of the madecassoside, and the low adherence to the skin was a letdown. Packaging: The container itself is quite bulky, making it feel larger than expected. On the plus side, the refill allows you to replace the entire inner container, which is more hygienic and neat. However, it's frustrating that the built­in tweezers keep falling off every time you open and close the lid. Be careful when opening the initial seal ­ it can be quite tough to remove, and if you use too much force, you might cut your hand. Please open it cautiously!

Positive aspects: I used it mainly on red marks after blemishes appeared, and I was satisfied to see the color fade after a few days. The pads are thick rather than thin, making them less irritating when wiping and sufficiently hydrating. Even when my skin is sensitive, it doesn't cause tingling or redness, so I can use it with peace of mind. Using the embossed side to refine skin texture, then wiping with the soft side makes the skin smooth. It's great as a toner substitute after cleansing or as a spot treatment mask on specific areas. Room for improvement: The lid is somewhat loose, so care is needed when transferring and storing refills. Tips: After cleansing, gently wipe along your skin texture with the embossed side first, then use the opposite side for a final touch. It's effective to leave it on for about 5 minutes as a soothing mask on areas prone to blemishes. Storing in the refrigerator adds a cooling effect that helps reduce puffiness. Make sure to seal the refill pack tightly when storing.

avis.titre: It was so cool and excellent...
avis.texte: It was so cool and excellent at calming blemishes that I loved applying it while drying my hair!!! The disappointing part was that the pad was made of gauze, so it didn't stretch, which was a bit of a letdown.

The pads are large and generously soaked in ampoule, making them perfect for soothing your face when it feels hot. After using an exfoliating toner, you can place them on your forehead or cheeks. They stay put well even while you're doing other things! The price point is a bit high, so I recommend purchasing during sales or promotions.

avis.titre: I used these pads when I was...
avis.texte: I used these pads when I was in 8th grade, and I remember they seemed to have some effect. However, the results weren't exactly mind­blowing, so I'm not sure if they're really worth it...

It's absolutely fantastic for acne and small bumps! Also great for reducing redness. It wasn't very effective for uneven skin texture. Didn't do much for hyperpigmentation either... When applied after washing your face in the morning, it's amazing for calming any signs of inflammation and heat.
It's great for providing hydration in a gentle way, so I use it as an evening mask I'm not sure if it actually helps with blemishes as the name suggests

The mask is generously soaked in essence and has a soft fabric, allowing for gentle application without irritation. When used as a mask, it significantly reduces heat in the skin. The next day, you'll notice that any discoloration has visibly faded. The texture isn't particularly refreshing, and those with oily skin might experience excess sebum production. If your skin condition isn't optimal, you might develop small bumps the following day. For best results, leave the mask on for 10 to 15 minutes. If you have ingrown hairs, applying the mask to those areas can be beneficial.

I used this product when blemishes appeared and after squeezing them! As someone with dry and combination dehydrated skin, I've always been concerned, but all Mediheal pads are great! I think there's nothing better for clearing up blemishes and fading their marks. I have a bad habit of squeezing blemishes with my fingers as soon as they appear, and I used to worry about the marks left behind. But after using this, those marks disappeared. Everyone should definitely try it! While it doesn't vanish overnight, keep using it consistently for best results. The only downside I can think of is that it's in a gauze form, which can be a bit uncomfortable. It works wonders when used after squeezing blemishes! When blemishes first appear, it's better to use the green pads instead!

avis.titre: Wow, this is really amazing! I...
avis.texte: Wow, this is really amazing! I only use these pads now. They're effective for blemishes and great for soothing the skin. The price is a bit steep. I wish they'd offer refills only. Every time I buy it, I feel like I'm contributing to environmental damage.

Effective for soothing blemish marks: You can definitely see acne scars gradually fading. It's not dramatically quick, but with consistent use, you'll notice visible improvement. 'Almost no irritation: Even on days when my skin was super sensitive, I could use it comfortably without any tingling or redness. It's gentle enough for daily use. 'Great for removing dead skin cells: After one use, my face feels smooth. When used before makeup, it really helps the makeup apply beautifully. 'Generous pad size: The pads are large enough to cover the entire face in one go. They're also great for leaving on cheeks as a mini mask. 'Slightly lacking in hydration: The essence isn't bad, but after it's fully absorbed, it feels a bit dry, so you need to apply moisturizer right away. 'Not an instant fix for blemishes: It doesn't seem to have a significant effect on calming active breakouts, but it does work on existing blemish marks. 'Has a slight scent: It's not unscented and has a subtle fragrance. I didn't mind it, but those sensitive to scents might find it noticeable. Using it the night before applying makeup makes a huge difference: It thoroughly removes dead skin cells, leaving your skin texture smooth. The difference is especially noticeable when used the night before an important day. For irritated skin days, try refrigerating the pads for an extra soothing effect: Placing the cool pad on cheeks or chin for about 5 minutes seems to calm redness. avis.titre: The pads are thin but packed...
avis.texte: The pads are thin but packed with essence, making them perfect for use while drying your hair! The included tweezers make application hygienic. When closing the lid, the tweezers that were attached often come loose. Sometimes when I go to use them again, they've fallen to the bottom and are hard to find...

avis.titre: I've been using this for two...
avis.texte: I've been using this for two months now, and I can't forget that amazing cooling effect when I first applied it! While the results aren't lightning­fast, they come pretty quickly. I love how it clears up blemishes and leaves my skin feeling smooth. I found myself using more product than expected when applying it to my face, so it ran out faster than I anticipated.

As someone with sensitive skin prone to inflammatory acne and acne scars, I was amazed by the results! After using this, my skin calmed down significantly, acne disappeared and stopped recurring, and even my acne scars faded considerably. I have dry and sensitive skin, and among all the toner pads I've tried, this seems to be the most effective. That's why I felt compelled to jot down this review... haha! I highly recommend this to anyone struggling with blemishes ­ you absolutely must give it a try! There wasn't anything particularly disappointing, but since I have extremely dry skin, it did feel a bit drying. However, everyone's skin is different, so if you're dealing with acne concerns, I'd still absolutely recommend giving this a shot!

Hydration + Skin texture improvement + Soothing These 3 benefits are absolutely fantastic! Putting it in the fridge for a bit before washing and applying it while blow­drying works wonders for calming the skin. Maybe it's because of the gauze material? It seems to adhere to the skin better. And refrigeration isn't even necessary! There's a slight cooling effect that seems to temporarily reduce redness! While the gauze material has its advantages, using it with an exfoliating toner can be too harsh on the skin. I wouldn't recommend it for those with super sensitive skin. Even if you don't have sensitive skin, it's probably best to avoid using exfoliating toners with this! Store it in the refrigerator before use!

avis.titre: This has become my go­to toner...
avis.texte: This has become my go­to toner pad now. My first toner pad was an exfoliating one, but now I've settled on Mediheal, which is both soothing and deeply hydrating. When I have extra time, I even use it as a toner mask before makeup. It really helps reduce skin temperature, making my foundation look flawless! The only inconvenience is that the toner pad tweezers inside the case often fall out, but I have no complaints about the product itself.

The cooling effect seems great for reducing skin heat. Applying it for 5­10 minutes before makeup helps calm the skin, allowing makeup to adhere better. I highly recommend this as a pre­makeup essential! The sheet mask doesn't seem to adhere well to the skin, possibly because it's made of gauze material.

This product is packed with hydration and quickly reduces heat, making it great for soothing the skin. It's my go­to pad on days when I need my makeup to look flawless or when my skin is acting up. While the gauze isn't particularly soft, so it's better for absorption rather than as an exfoliating toner, I've still used it a lot for gentle exfoliation! I've gone through about three bottles myself. Definitely a must­buy for those with oily skin! The gauze isn't the softest, and the price might be a concern... But other than that, it's a great product! If you leave it on for about 5 minutes before applying makeup and then gently pat it in with your hands, you'll get an amazing Inner Glow!

I've already purchased 4 containers!! It's ranked #1 on every cosmetics site, so I bought it on a whim, and these points really impressed me: 1. Makeup applies beautifully I have combination, sensitive skin with visible pores, so my makeup often looks patchy and dries out quickly. But when I use this before applying makeup, it quickly reduces any heat in my skin and helps my makeup adhere smoothly and stay put. 2. Great for everyday use Compared to other pads, the scent isn't overpowering, the price is reasonable, and you get a good amount. Most importantly, there's plenty of serum in each pad ­ you can tell just by shaking the container! While it may not dramatically reduce blemishes if that's what you're expecting, this excellent pad more than makes up for it in other areas.

First off, it really enhances makeup application. It seems to have had quite an effect on blemishes too. The pad size is generous enough to cover even my large face completely. Never use it as a spot treatment! Always use it as a full­face mask. Applying it directly on blemishes causes way too much irritation.

This product truly saved my skin! At first, I tried it because everyone around me was raving about it. I didn't see results immediately and thought I'd wasted my money, but with consistent use, my blemishes just disappeared... It's revolutionary! I was worried the gauze might be rough, but it was surprisingly gentle and thin, making it comfortable to wear. There's honestly nothing to complain about... Really, nothing at all. Unless you have extremely, incredibly super sensitive skin, you'll be absolutely fine with this.

As someone with combination dehydrated skin and acne scars, I found this product to be gentle and quite decent overall. I had high hopes after experiencing a revelation with their sheet mask, but this didn't quite live up to that level of amazement.

Compared to the Mediheal Tea Tree Pads, I really liked the cooling effect this product provides. While blemishes don't disappear dramatically, I felt like they were gradually fading away! The adherence to the face is disappointing. It lifts and falls off with even the slightest movement...

For sensitive combination dehydrated skin with lots of blemishes: The built­in tweezers reduce the risk of losing them and make it easy to peel off one sheet at a time. I applied one to each cheek and a diamond shape on the forehead to cover the T­zone. Everyone says the adhesion is good, but is it really? The pad lifts or moves even with the slightest facial movement, hmm... The hydration is decent and it feels nice to use, but my skin didn't improve or worsen, so it's a product I used without much fuss. The material is a sturdy gauze texture, which feels refreshing when you pat it on your skin ­ that's really nice. Because of the gauze material, when peeling the pads from the container, there were sometimes loose threads or fibers attached, which was a bit inconvenient. It feels overpriced for its average performance. It might be good to use before makeup or on important days, but for regular use, just using a toner pack with a cotton pad soaked in water­based toner seems sufficient.

This stuff is seriously amazing. I secretly used my sister's for 3 days and saw my blemishes fading right away, so I immediately bought my own... It's incredibly effective ­ you can literally see the results as it works to even your skin tone. The hydration is fantastic, and it also works great as an exfoliating toner. It didn't work for me personally. My friends haven't seen dramatic results either, but they still use it because it keeps their skin nicely hydrated.

It feels hydrating, leaving the skin moisturized and has a soothing effect. The front side is soft, while the back is slightly textured. When you want to remove dead skin cells, gently wipe with the back side, then finish with the soft front side. I also found it nice to use as a mask by placing it on the cheeks. However, it can occasionally fall off when drying your hair, which is a bit disappointing. Also, the built­in tweezers make it difficult to pick up the pads. It would be great if they could improve this with tweezers that grip better.

avis.titre: I tried these toner pads since...
avis.texte: I tried these toner pads since they're famous for targeting blemishes. While I'm not sure about their effectiveness on blemishes, I can say that when stored cold and applied, they have an amazing soothing effect! The texture seems too rough to use as an exfoliating toner, and I found it difficult to properly adhere the pads to my face.

avis.titre: This toner is so generous with...
avis.texte: This toner is so generous with its content! It adheres really well to the skin, making it perfect for use while blow­drying your hair. Despite being called a 'trace pad', it wasn't effective in reducing acne scars or small blemishes. Quite disappointing.

avis.titre: Can be used like a mask.
avis.texte: Can be used like a mask. It really fills the skin with hydration. I've been using it as the first step in my skincare routine, and I can definitely feel the difference when I apply makeup after using it versus when I don't! I'm on my third bottle and haven't felt any disappointment with its effectiveness yet. However, since the mask sheets are thin, I have to use the included tweezers to separate them one by one, which feels a bit inconvenient. I heard it's been renewed, but I guess this can't be helped.

The gauze­like texture of the pads makes it easy to remove dead skin cells and helps reduce skin heat. The scent is slightly reminiscent of red ginseng, which might be hit or miss for some. While the gauze texture is good for exfoliation, some threads come loose when patting it on the skin. The tweezers provided for hygienic use don't grip well and break easily. Due to the gauze texture, those with super sensitive skin should be gentle when applying it to the face.

This is an absolute must­try! It's the real MVP for brightening skin and significantly fading blemishes! The only downside is that the cotton fibers from the toner pads often stick to my face during application, which can be a bit annoying. Otherwise, it's great!
